title: rev-stealth auth --output-format json
description:
JSON payload emitted by `rev-stealth auth {login|list|show|delete|status|refresh} --output-format json`. v1.3 Lane G.4 contract.

IMPORTANT — two distinct OK shapes coexist on this surface:

1. `list` / `show` / `delete` / `status` success and ALL error paths flow through `crates/stealth-cli/src/commands/auth.rs::emit_ok`/`emit_err` and use the shared `{ok, operation, result|exit_code+error}` envelope.

2. `login` / `refresh` SUCCESS is emitted by the external `rev-auth` helper binary (`crates/stealth-auth/src/bin/rev_auth.rs`), whose stdout is inherited by the CLI. That helper writes a FLAT `SuccessJson` shape with no envelope: `{ok, profile, domain, cookie_count, expires_at, saved_to}`. The CLI's `auth.login` / `auth.refresh` ENVELOPE is only used for *errors* (policy-load, AUP, VPN-guard, spawn-failure) before the helper is invoked.

This split is documented honestly rather than being papered over — collapsing the two surfaces onto one envelope requires changing `rev-auth` (out of scope for G.4, which is strict-additive).

Cookie *values* are NEVER serialized in either shape; only sha256 prefixes (envelope path) and counts/expires_at (flat path).

oneOf.title: Shared OK envelope (list / show / delete / status; never login / refresh success)

result.description: anyOf (not oneOf) because the payload shapes overlap structurally (e.g. delete_payload is a superset of show_or_login_payload's required fields). Live emission disambiguates via the parent `operation` enum.

exit_code.description: 0 ok / 1 user / 3 permanent / 4 auth-expired / aborted variants per crates/stealth-cli/src/commands/auth.rs::EXIT_*.

oneOf.title: rev-auth login/refresh SUCCESS (flat SuccessJson; no envelope)
oneOf.description: Emitted by `crates/stealth-auth/src/bin/rev_auth.rs` line 212 (struct) / line 382 (println). The CLI's `auth.login` / `auth.refresh` success path inherits this stdout verbatim — see `crates/stealth-cli/src/commands/auth.rs::spawn_rev_auth_login` (line 406).

show_or_login_payload.title: auth.show result (also: shape historically aliased for login/refresh envelope, but live login/refresh success uses rev_auth_success instead)

rev_auth_success.title: rev-auth helper SuccessJson (login / refresh success path)
rev_auth_success.description: Flat success shape printed by `rev-auth login` and inherited by `rev-stealth auth login` / `rev-stealth auth refresh`. Mirror of `crates/stealth-auth/src/bin/rev_auth.rs::SuccessJson` (line 212). No `operation` / no `result` wrapper.

expires_at.description: Latest cookie expiry (RFC 3339), or null when no cookie carries an expiry.
